title: Genome-scale perturb-seq in primary human CD4+ T cells maps context-specific regulators of T cell programs and human immune traits
title_zh: 基因组规模的扰动测序在原代人类CD4+ T细胞中绘制了上下文特异性调控因子，揭示T细胞程序和人类免疫特征的调控网络
abstract: Gene regulatory networks encode the fundamental logic of cellular functions, but systematic network mapping remains challenging, especially in cell states relevant to human biology and disease. Here, we perturbed all expressed genes across 22 million primary human CD4+ T cells from four donors and developed a probe-based perturb-seq platform to measure the transcriptome effects in cells at rest and after stimulation. These data allowed us to map genes regulating immune pathways, including previously uncharacterized regulators of cytokine production. Importantly, active regulators and the gene programs they control changed dramatically across stimulation conditions. Perturbation signatures enabled us to model T cell states observed in population-scale transcriptomic atlases, nominating regulators of T cell polarization and of age-related phenotypes. Finally, we leveraged perturb-seq to implicate context-specific gene regulatory pathways in autoimmune disease risk. Our study provides a foundational resource and new approaches to decode T cell function and human immune traits.
abstract_zh: 基因调控网络编码了细胞功能的基本逻辑，但系统化的网络映射仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在与人类生物学和疾病相关的细胞状态中。我们在来自四个供体的2200万原代人类CD4+ T细胞中扰动了所有表达基因，并开发了一种基于探针的扰动测序平台，以测量静息状态和刺激后细胞的转录组效应。这些数据使我们能够绘制调控免疫通路的基因图谱，包括先前未被表征的细胞因子产生调控因子。重要的是，活跃调控因子及其控制的基因程序在不同刺激条件下发生了显著变化。扰动特征使我们能够模拟在群体规模转录组图谱中观察到的T细胞状态，提出了T细胞极化和与年龄相关表型的调控因子。最后，我们利用扰动测序将上下文特异性的基因调控通路与自身免疫疾病风险联系起来。我们的研究提供了一个基础资源和新的方法，用于解码T细胞功能和人类免疫特征。
